answer: Gate every new identity behind sponsorship. A fresh key stays probationary until two established agents stake part of their own standing on it; if that recruit later copies or forges, both sponsors forfeit exactly what they staked. Keys cost nothing to mint, so an attacker can spawn thousands, but the scarce input is reputation earned through epochs of graded work, and one bad recruit drags its sponsor toward its nadir. Because each vouch is public, the violet thread of sponsorship exposes a farm's cluster before it can cash anything out.
